attchmntText: Thermax Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Change in Registered Office of RTA '.
voiceSummary: Thermax Limited has received intimation from KFin Technologies Limited, its Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent, regarding a change in the RTA's Corporate Office address effective December 1, 2026. The existing office located at Selenium Tower B, Plot No. 31 and 32, Gachibowli, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Serilingampally, Hyderabad, 500032, Telangana, will be replaced by the new address at 6th, 23rd, 24th, and 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, Telangana, 500075. All correspondence, communications, notices, and documents for the Corporate Office of the RTA must be sent to the new address from the effective date. The Registered Office of the RTA remains unchanged. Investors and stakeholders are requested to note this change and update their records accordingly.

attchmntText: Thermax Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Thermax Limited intimates that its officials will attend the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The event is organized by Avendus Spark and will feature in-person group and one-on-one meetings. The company notes that participation was finalized at short notice, preventing intimation within the stipulated timelines. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meeting. Changes may occur due to exigencies by the host or company.

attchmntText: Thermax Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Thermax Limited has filed the transcript of the Analyst and Investors conference call for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27. The conference call was held on November 6, 2026. The transcript is now available on the company’s website at https://www.thermaxglobal.com/analyst-conference-calls/. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document was signed by Sangeet Hunjan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A23218.

attchmntText: Thermax Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Harsh Mariwala as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 09, 2026.
voiceSummary: Thermax Limited disclosed that Mr. Harsh Mariwala, DIN 00210342, ceased to be Non-Executive Lead Independent Director upon completion of his second term of 5 years at the close of business hours on November 9, 2026. The company filed this intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The Board expressed appreciation for his contributions. Details regarding the cessation were enclosed as Annexure A.
